content:
Context: 5. Honorarium admissible for specific cases.

| Honorarium | I | Where the number of witnesses cited in the charge-sheet is more than 10 | 90% of monthly basic pension drawn |
| Honorarium | II | Where the number of witnesses cited in the charge-sheet are between 6-10 | 70% of monthly basic pension drawn |
| Honorarium | Ill | Where the number of witnesses cited in the charge-sheet is less than 6 | 60% of monthly basic pension drawn |
